'''Annie Silver''' is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Pokémon roles==
Silver joined {{aniseries|PTS}} when [[The Pokémon Company International|Pokémon USA]] took over the dubbing and distribution of it. She has not voiced after season 10.
